closing: “The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.” James 5:16 KJV

settings.heading: Experiencing the Joy of Prayer
settings.intro: Learn to pray through twelve simple movements as we look {up} to God, welcome His work {in} us, and pray {out} for others and the world.
settings.credits: Scripture quotations marked KJV are from the King James Version, public domain.

movements.title: Be Still
movements.summary: Quiet your heart and turn your full attention to God.
movements.text: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
movements.prompt: Take a few slow breaths. Release the noise of the day and simply rest in God’s presence. Tell Him, “Here I am.”
movements.full_prompts:
Name what is pulling at your attention, and set each thing down before God.
Pray slowly: “Here I am, Lord. I’m listening.”
Sit in silence and let His love settle over you.

movements.title: Praise
movements.summary: Worship God for who He is.
movements.text: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.
movements.prompt: Praise God for who He is: His holiness, His power, His faithfulness, His love. Speak or sing your praise.
movements.full_prompts:
Praise God as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
Choose one attribute of God and praise Him for it in your own words.
Read a psalm of praise aloud.

movements.title: Give Thanks
movements.summary: Thank God for what He has done.
movements.text: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
movements.prompt: Thank God for specific gifts from today, this week, and this year. Name them one by one.
movements.full_prompts:
Thank God for spiritual blessings: salvation, forgiveness, His Word.
Thank Him for the people He has placed in your life.
Thank Him for something hard that He has used for good.

movements.title: Pray the Word
movements.text: For the word of God is quick, and powerful, and sharper than any twoedged sword, piercing even to the dividing asunder of soul and spirit, and of the joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.
movements.prompt: Read a passage slowly. Turn its words into your own prayer back to God.
movements.full_prompts:
Read today’s passage twice, slowly.
What does it show you about God? Praise Him for it.
What does it ask of you? Ask for grace to obey.
movements.rotation:
Psalm 23
Psalm 27
Psalm 63
Psalm 91
Psalm 103
Psalm 139
Psalm 145

movements.title: Listen
movements.summary: Make room to hear from God.
movements.text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
movements.prompt: Be quiet before God. Ask, “Lord, what do You want to say to me?” Wait, and write down what comes to mind.
movements.full_prompts:
Ask the Holy Spirit to bring to mind anything He wants you to see.
Test what you sense against Scripture.
Write down one thing to carry into your day.

movements.title: Surrender
movements.text: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
movements.prompt: Give God your plans, your time, your relationships, and your fears. Pray, “Not my will, but Yours be done.”
movements.full_prompts:
Open your hands as a sign of surrender.
Name one plan or worry you are holding tightly, and release it.
Ask to be filled with the Holy Spirit.

movements.title: Confession
movements.text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
movements.prompt: Ask God to search your heart. Confess what He shows you, and receive His forgiveness.
movements.full_prompts:
Pray Psalm 139:23–24 slowly.
Is there anyone you need to forgive? Release them to God.
Thank Jesus that you are fully forgiven.

movements.title: Intercede
movements.summary: Stand in the gap for others.
movements.text: Confess your faults one to another, and pray one for another, that ye may be healed. The effectual fervent prayer of a righteous man availeth much.
movements.prompt: Pray for the people on your heart: family, friends, neighbors, coworkers, and those who are hurting.
movements.full_prompts:
Pray by name for those who don’t yet know Jesus.
Pray for the sick, the grieving, and the lonely.
Pray through your personal requests below.
movements.rotation:
Your family
Friends and neighbors
Coworkers and classmates
The sick and those who care for them
The grieving and the lonely
Those who are far from God
Those who have hurt you

movements.title: Pray for {church} and the Church
movements.summary: Pray for your church family and the whole Body of Christ.
movements.text: Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that worketh in us, unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.
movements.prompt: Pray for your pastors, staff, ministries, and people. Pray for the whole Church to be united and on mission.
movements.full_prompts:
Pray for unity, love, and faithfulness to the Word.
Pray for new believers and those returning to faith.
Pray for other churches in {city} by name.
movements.rotation:
Sunday worship and preaching
Pastors, elders, and staff
Children, students, and families
Small groups and discipleship
Care ministries and those in need
Missionaries and partners
Churches across {city}

lists.label: View all {count} churches in {city}
lists.intro: Pray for each by name: for faithful preaching, unity among churches, and love for {city}.

movements.title: Pray for {City}
movements.summary: Seek the peace and flourishing of {city}.
movements.text: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.
movements.prompt: Pray for the people, leaders, schools, workplaces, and neighborhoods of {city}.
movements.full_prompts:
Pray for the neighbors on your street by name.
Pray for justice, safety, and mercy in {city}.
Ask God how you can be His presence where you live.
movements.rotation:
Your neighborhood
City and county leaders
Schools, teachers, and students
Police, firefighters, and first responders
The poor, the unhoused, and the vulnerable
Businesses, artists, and workers
Hospitals and healthcare workers

movements.title: Pray for Your Nation
movements.summary: Pray for your nation and those in authority.
movements.text: If my people, which are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heaven, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
movements.prompt: Pray for leaders at every level, for justice and mercy, and for spiritual awakening.
movements.full_prompts:
Pray for leaders you agree with and leaders you don’t.
Pray for reconciliation where there is division.
Pray for a great awakening to Jesus.
movements.rotation:
Spiritual revival and awakening
National leaders
Courts and lawmakers
The military and their families
Unity and reconciliation
Marriages and families
The next generation

movements.title: Pray for the World
movements.summary: Pray for the nations and the spread of the gospel.
movements.text: Then saith he unto his disciples, The harvest truly is plenteous, but the labourers are few; pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest.
movements.prompt: Pray for the gospel to reach every people, for the persecuted church, and for peace where there is war.
movements.full_prompts:
Ask the Lord of the harvest to send out workers.
Pray for believers who suffer for their faith.
Pray for missionaries your church supports.
movements.rotation:
Unreached people groups
Africa
Asia
Europe
Latin America and the Caribbean
The Middle East and North Africa
The persecuted church

lists.label: View all publicly listed {church} missionaries
lists.intro: Pray for each by name: for health, safety, fruitful work, strong friendships, and joy.

lists.label: View all {count} countries & prayer prompts
lists.intro: Pray through one country or several. Ask God to draw people to Jesus and to bless the church there.

lists.label: Ten ways to pray for persecuted Christians
lists.intro: Hebrews 13:3 asks us to remember those in prison as if we were there with them.
lists.items:
Stand firm | that they would stay faithful and know Christ is with them.
Courage | to speak of Jesus boldly and with love.
Protection | for families, children, and church leaders.
Prisoners | for comfort, fair treatment, and release.
Provision | for those who have lost jobs, homes, or land for their faith.
Healing | for those who are injured and those who grieve.
Secret believers | for those who cannot worship openly.
Persecutors | that those who oppress believers would meet Jesus.
Leaders | for governments to protect freedom of faith.
Witness | that the church would grow stronger and the gospel would spread.

lists.label: View all {count} countries and prayer requests
lists.intro: Countries where Christians face the greatest pressure for their faith.

lists.label: How to pray for global situations
lists.intro: When the news is heavy, pray through it step by step.
lists.items:
Name it | the place, the people, and what is happening.
Those suffering | safety, food, shelter, healing, and comfort.
Those helping | aid workers, medical teams, and local churches.
Those in authority | wisdom, justice, and an end to violence.
Peace | reconciliation where there is conflict.
The church | that local believers would shine in hard places.
Keep going | keep praying after the news moves on.

starters.passage: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.
This is the day which the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
O give thanks unto the LORD, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.
Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid.
And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature.
